text.en:
Dive to the ground and create a burst of Solar Light that cures nearby allies.

While Heat Rises is active, you gain restoration while diving and scorch targets upon landing.

Performs a dive to the ground in the direction of your movement input. Not inputting a movement direction results in a vertical dive downward.

Applies <solar/>Cure x2 to you and allies within 9 meters upon landing.

Grants additional benefits if <solar/>Heat Rises is active:
Grants you <solar/>Restoration x2 for 3 seconds instantly upon actication. Deals 100 Damage and applies 40 <solar/>Scorch Stacks (60 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) to enemies within 5 meters upon landing.
